Description: 
NOTICE OF SESSION 
SUPERVISORS OF THE CHECKLIST, GILFORD 
Wednesday October 21, 2026, 10:00 a.m. – 10:30 a.m. 
Gilford Town Hall, Office of Supervisors 
Gilford, NH 
Notice_of_Session_10-21-2026.docx 
Pending registrations, updates, and removals pertaining to the Voter Checklist will be considered at this time and the public may visit with new registrations, questions or changes to voter record. The public Voter Checklist is posted in the Town Clerk’s office. 
This is the last opportunity for the supervisors to accept voter registration applications before the New Hampshire state general election on November 3, 2026. No additions or corrections to the Voter Checklist shall be made until that day except as provided in RSA 659:12 and RSA 654:8,II. 
New registrants should bring a photo ID, proof of residency and proof of citizenship. 
If you do not have proof of citizenship, you may complete a Qualified Voter Affidavit, under the penalties of perjury. 
YOU MAY CHECK YOUR PARTY, FIND YOUR POLLING PLACE, AND MORE BY GOING TO: http://app.sos.nh.gov. 
SUPERVISORS OF THE CHECKLIST: 
Mary Villaume, Chair 
Miriam York 
Andrea Stephan
